modules.module_title: Assist in conducting pre operation checks

pcs.pc_description: examine the body components for cracks and bearing wear visually
help in checking the boom and stick for dents and cracked welds
assist with the inspection of all ground- engaging tools to guarantee their stability
check that the oil levels in the engine, gearbox, radiant coolant, and brakes are in accordance with the manufacturer's recommendations
assist in checking differential and hydraulic oil levels
check the tension of the fan belt, the electrolyte level, and the terminal tightness
visually inspect the different controls, gauges, warning lights, and confirm that all safety and maintenance stickers are present
check load chart is displayed in cabin
regularly clean dust in the air filter bowl
drain water and sediment from the fuel tank
carry out inspections to verify that the parking brake, main horn, reverse horn, and headlight are in proper working order
grease all greasing pins and pivots points well
examine the compressor unit and all fittings and air lines
examine the clearance between the drawbar ball and socket, look for excessive free play, and correct as needed
make sure the locking bar is in place to keep the front and back chassis from shifting and creating a crushing zone (articulated machines only)
clean the footplates and steps to maintain them free of mud, dirt, and grease
before operating, walk thoroughly around the backhoe loader to ensure that no one is beneath or on the machine
get the log book of activities performed approved by the operator
assist in maintaining logbook to record all activities performed before starting the backhoe loader
if a fault is found that is outside of the scope of the position, notify the operator immediately
